summary: Implemented the Tabs feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run and nothing was committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges and now yields one Text with click spans; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style so metadata is kept; added a required underline test and tests/test_tabs.py; added docs/reference/tabs.md and an optional sandbox demo. Decisions to review: click action is range_clicked('name') with the name quoted, because the action parser literal-evals its argument; the bar position uses the displayed-tab index so duplicate names underline the right tab, which departs from the literal find_tab_by_name wording; the layout resolver needed no change because Edge already declares min_size. Known limitation: with duplicate names, left and right navigation can cycle without reaching tabs past the duplicate. Tests have not been run.
